entries.title: Operation Blue Skies: Reducing aviation climate impact with AI
entries.summary: A high-altitude view of a commercial airplane flying above a layer of clouds, with a distinct white contrail trailing behind it.
entries.content:
When you look up at a clear sky and see thin white lines trailing behind airplanes, you’re looking at condensation trails, or "contrails." These are clouds created when water vapor condenses around soot particles in jet exhaust. While they may seem harmless, these warming contrails account for roughly one third of aviation’s total climate impact. Today, we’re announcing a new step in our efforts to help the industry avoid contrails.

Since publishing our initial research on ways AI can help mitigate contrail warming, we've partnered across the aviation industry, working alongside airlines such as American Airlines, air navigation service providers like EUROCONTROL's MUAC, and Flight Planning Software providers including FlightKeys, to demonstrate that avoiding warming contrails is both scientifically validated and operationally practical. Our AI-powered forecasts have enabled flight crews and air traffic controllers to make targeted adjustments that avoid contrail-sensitive regions while remaining within normal flight operations.

Now, we’re taking the next major step: expanding beyond individual airline trials to coordinated contrail mitigation across an entire flight corridor. We’re launching Operation Blue Skies — the world’s first state-backed trial to avoid contrails at the scale of an entire oceanic airspace.

Operation Blue Skies will operate within the eastern half of the North Atlantic corridor, Shanwick airspace, which accounts for approximately 5% of global contrail warming. 1 The 30 month program consists of two operational trials, each lasting approximately four months. Around 10,000 flights, originating from hundreds of cities, will pass through Shanwick airspace during trial hours each year and a small percentage of these flights that would otherwise pass through contrail-sensitive airspace will be slightly deviated, preventing them from forming strongly warming contrails.

A landmark consortium for global impact

Achieving airspace-scale contrail avoidance requires close collaboration across science, technology, and air traffic management. Operation Blue Skies brings together a world-leading UK consortium with the expertise to turn cutting-edge research into operational reality:

  • Google UK: Developing AI models to predict and avoid warming contrails, while using machine learning and satellite imaging to track and verify our impact.
  • NATS (the UK's leading air navigation service provider): Trial airspace operations, air traffic control coordination, safety assessment and air traffic controller training.
  • Contrails.org: Leading forecast assessments, designing trial parameters, and supporting data analysis.
  • Imperial College London & University of Cambridge: Evaluating trial outcomes and providing independent verification of climate impact.
  • Met Office: Developing a new UK contrail forecast capability and ensuring meteorological accuracy throughout the trial.

Operation Blue Skies programme is co-funded by its industry partners and the Department for Transport (DfT) through the ATI Programme, a partnership between the Aerospace Technology Institute (ATI), the Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade (BIST) and Innovate UK. To ensure public funding directly advances sovereign scientific capabilities, 100% of the government grant funding is allocated directly to academic, non-profit, and aviation partners.

Google UK is participating on a pro-bono basis, contributing £1.4 million in-kind through AI research expertise, engineering time, and high-performance computing infrastructure to advance open climate science.

A blueprint for the future of flight

Contrails are one of the most urgent yet solvable climate challenges facing aviation today. Research suggests that avoiding contrails could be one of the most cost-effective ways to reduce aviation’s climate impact. 2 Addressing this challenge requires new approaches that combine scientific insight, advanced technology, and operational innovation. Operation Blue Skies aims to demonstrate that solving the challenge of contrails is operationally practical, providing a validated blueprint for how our airspaces can be managed to drastically reduce aviation's climate impact.

If you’re part of the aviation industry and interested in advancing contrail mitigation through collaboration or participation, we’d love to hear from you. Please contact our team to learn more about opportunities to get involved.

entries.title: Get closer to the game with Gemini and Pixel
entries.summary: Low-angle view of a soccer player kicking a ball mid-air against a bright blue sky, with grass flying from their cleats.
entries.content:
We’re launching new long-term partnerships with five of the world’s most iconic football clubs: Arsenal FC, FC Barcelona, FC Bayern München, Liverpool FC, and Paris Saint-Germain. As their Official Consumer AI and Official Smartphone Partner, Gemini and Pixel are coming together to help put fans right at the heart of the action.

Supercharging match days with Gemini

Football culture is fueled by the stories that define the game, both on and off the pitch. With Gemini as their personal assistant, supporters can dive deeper into match and club insights and stay connected to the moments that matter most.

Whether you’re dissecting a mid-game formation change in the midst of a European club clash or settling a post-match debate with precise head-to-head history, Gemini’s advanced agentic capabilities proactively handle tasks on your behalf and put answers right in your hands, keeping you at the heart of the action.

Bringing you a new angle on the game with Pixel

As the Official Smartphone Partner, Google Pixel is working with club media teams to capture all the raw, unfiltered moments and emotions behind the scenes of the match.

Through our signature "Shot on Pixel" series, club social teams will use Pixel’s camera with our AI tools to share fresh, authentic perspectives. Plus, you can already show your colors by customizing your Pixel 11 device with official club wallpapers.

Raising the visibility of women's football

A fundamental part of these partnerships is our commitment to help closing the visibility gap in women’s football. Record-breaking crowds are watching women's tournaments, yet the game still lacks the media coverage and visibility it deserves.

By partnering equally across both men’s and women’s teams, we are putting our technology to work to help change that. Together with the clubs we will capture jaw dropping pitch-side action, produce unforgettable content, and amplify the reach of the women’s game globally - driving the visibility needed to help inspire the next generation of players and fans.

Across our partner clubs

We are incredibly proud to collaborate with Arsenal FC, FC Barcelona, FC Bayern München, Liverpool FC and Paris Saint-Germain - clubs that represent the very best of football heritage and community across Europe's top leagues. Together, we will deliver exclusive behind-the-scenes content, matchday insights and new AI-powered fan experiences to bring supporters closer to the stories and stats that define their favorite teams.

Follow our partner clubs' official channels — Arsenal FC, FC Barcelona, FC Bayern München, Liverpool FC and Paris Saint-Germain and @GooglePixel and @GoogleGemini — to see these stories unfold and get closer to the game this season.

entries.title: Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash
entries.summary: Spark icon next to the text "Gemini 3.7 Flash", all on a light blue backgorund
entries.content:
Today, we’re building on the progress of our widely used Flash series by introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash, our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents.

This release comes just three weeks after Gemini 3.6 Flash, and is a direct result of developer feedback and algorithmic innovations that we look forward to bringing to future models. 3.7 Flash delivers substantial improvements across software engineering, knowledge work, and web development workflows — with an introductory price of half the original 3.6 Flash cost per million tokens.

Better intelligence for complex workflows

3.7 Flash shows strong gains over 3.6 Flash in coding tasks like debugging and issue resolution. It also achieves higher first-pass code accuracy and has improved performance in generating production-ready code as seen in FrontierCode 1.1 Main (43.6% vs 34.4%) and DeepSWE v1.1 (65.3% vs 49.0%).

In web development, 3.7 Flash generates more functional layouts and feature-complete apps in fewer prompts. For UI generation, the model shows high design adherence and parity based on a reference input, whether it’s a screenshot, an image, or a full design system. It outperforms 3.6 Flash on Arena.ai’s WebDev Arena with an Elo score of 1588 vs 1538.

For knowledge-dense fields like finance, law, and biosciences, 3.7 Flash delivers improved reasoning and accuracy. It significantly outperforms 3.6 Flash on the GDP.pdf benchmark (34.0% vs 22.0%), an eval for testing a model’s ability to process complex documents. It also surpasses 3.6 Flash in AutomationBench, demonstrating it can more effectively complete real-world business workflows (30.4% vs 17.0%).

Better developer experience and price

Gemini 3.7 Flash delivers a noticeably improved developer experience over 3.6 Flash. It better adapts to roadblocks, clarifies intent when needed, and follows instructions with greater fidelity. It thinks more diligently, putting in more effort into multi-step planning and tool calls. A more disciplined execution means less manual oversight and fewer retries across engineering workflows.

3.7 Flash is available through the end of the year at an introductory price 1 of $0.75/1M input tokens and $3.75/1M output tokens. This price combined with the enhanced model performance enables developers and customers to scale production-ready agents cost effectively.

Early customer feedback is highlighting 3.7 Flash’s performance and precision, achieving results that are significantly better than 3.6 Flash at a low cost.

Improving Gemini Spark with 3.7 Flash

Gemini Spark, available to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in over 160 countries, will be using Gemini 3.7 Flash starting today. We launched Spark at I/O as your personal AI agent that runs 24/7, taking action on your behalf while under your direction. This model update makes Spark more efficient for knowledge work with improved tool use for Google Workspace apps, delivering improved accuracy and output quality for complex, multi-skill workflows.

With 3.7 Flash, Gemini Spark can turn ideas into action more efficiently by consolidating files, drafting emails, and updating status documents.

Built with safety in mind

We continually work to improve the coverage and robustness of Frontier Safety safeguards. Gemini 3.7 Flash is shipping with updated safeguards against misuse in the domains of Chemical, Biological, Radiological, and Nuclear (CBRN) and cyber offense, while enabling beneficial use cases, in accordance with our approach to bioresilience and our cyber program.

For more information, see the 3.7 Flash model card.

Try it today

  • Developers: Explore agent-first workflows in Google Antigravity or start building today in the Gemini API via Google AI Studio and Android Studio. Get started with our developer guide.
  • Enterprises: Access 3.7 Flash in Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform and the Gemini Enterprise app.
  • Individuals: Available via Spark, your 24/7 personal agent in the Gemini app for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in supported countries.

entries.title: Bring your spreadsheet data to life with Sheets canvas
entries.summary: The video shows Sheets canvas in action.
entries.content:
Spreadsheets are a powerful tool for organizing and understanding data, but staring at hundreds of rows and columns can sometimes feel a bit overwhelming. Whether you’re planning a wedding, tracking school assignments, managing a fantasy football roster, or comparing side hustle income, you want to see what you need to know from your data quickly.

To help get you there, we’re introducing Sheets canvas, a new feature built with Gemini that turns your Google Sheets spreadsheets into custom, interactive "mini-apps." With a simple natural language prompt, you can transform your data into a visual experience that’s easy to understand and even easier to use.

Visualize your data in new ways

Sheets canvas is a dynamic, read-write layer that sits directly on top of your spreadsheet data. This means that you can visually organize, edit, and navigate your data in whatever layout you imagine.

Here is what makes it so powerful.

  • No coding required: No formulas or programming required. Just describe what you want — like "create a visual study tracker" — and Gemini builds it for you.
  • Always in sync: Whether you make changes to your canvas or to your sheet, updates are synced between the canvas and the original sheet in real time.
  • Easy to adjust: You can continue to polish and refine your Sheets canvas by prompting Gemini to make edits to layout, design, functionality, and more.
  • Fully collaborative: Since it lives as a tab in Google Sheets, your canvas can be shared with anyone, just like a regular sheet.

See it in action

We designed Sheets canvas to be as flexible as your imagination. Here are a few examples to show how you can start using it today.

1. Stay on top of the school year

For students, managing multiple subjects and deadlines is a full-time job. With Sheets canvas, you can turn a long list of assignments into an interactive study aid. Track progress, set reminders, and visualize the week ahead so you never miss a deadline.

2. Dominate your fantasy football league

Take your fantasy team to the next level by using Sheets canvas to build the ultimate command center for your roster. Create a custom dashboard to track player performance, compare stats side by side, and clearly visualize your path to the championship — all powered by the data in your sheet.

3. Simplify wedding planning

Juggling seating arrangements and meal choices just got infinitely easier. Sheets canvas transforms your guest RSVP data into an interactive seating chart. Just drag and drop guests to their tables, and rest easy knowing your central sheet stays up to date.

Try it now

Sheets canvas is now available globally in English to Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers. It's rolling out starting today to Google Workspace customers on Business or Enterprise Standard and Plus plans, and to Google AI Pro for Education add-on subscribers.

Ready to see your data in a whole new light? Open a Google Sheets spreadsheet and select the “Create canvas” option in the Ask Gemini side panel to get started. Check out this article for more tips.

entries.title: Stay present while taking pictures with Magic Capture on Pixel 11.
entries.summary: Pixel 11’s new Magic Capture feature finds the best shots from dynamic scenes so you don’t miss precious moments trying to capture them.
entries.content:
Many of life’s most precious moments happen fast. And we want you to be present for them, not distracted by your camera. That’s why we’re introducing Magic Capture, a new Pixel 11 feature that can automatically catch blink-and-you’ll-miss-it shots and video with just a single tap, allowing you to focus on what matters most.

Just start your Magic Capture session when there’s something you want to document — like when someone’s about to blow out the candles on a birthday cake. In a typical session, Magic Capture will analyze almost 400 frames of that moment to create well-timed, high-quality photos. It can pick out a great smile, a genuine laugh, or an action photo. And if you opt in, it can also apply light edits, like cropping, straightening, or unblurring, where appropriate.

Try Magic Capture on any Pixel 11 phone. The phones are available for preorder, and they’ll be on shelves at the Google Store and our retail partners August 20. Visit the Google Store for more information on availability and product updates.

And watch the video below to see Shenaz Zack, senior director of product management for Pixel, show exactly how Magic Capture works.

entries.title: Get updates while your Pixel 11 Pro is face down with HiLight.
entries.summary: HiLight, a new Pixel 11 Pro feature, gently glows to notify you of timely updates — keeping you informed when your phone is down.
entries.content:
Our latest Pixel Pro phones come with HiLight, a new feature that helps you stay present by minimizing distractions. HiLight uses color-coded lights to notify you of certain timely information so you can stay informed without having to look at your screen.

Let’s say you’ve prompted Gemini. HiLight will glow in different patterns to signal when Gemini’s listening, thinking, or responding. You can also assign custom colors for incoming calls from the people who matter most to you — so if your phone is ringing, you can know at a glance if you want to answer it or if you should let it go to voicemail.

We’re introducing HiLight on Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold, which are available for preorder, starting at $1,099, $1,299 and $1,899. All three phones will be on shelves at the Google Store and through our retail partners August 20. Visit the Google Store for more information on availability and product updates.

entries.title: Omni experts share what excites them most about the model.
entries.summary: We interviewed some of the experts behind Gemini Omni to hear what excites them most about the model.
entries.content:
We recently introduced Gemini Omni, a new model that lets you create anything from any input. The model’s first release, Gemini Omni Flash, makes generating and editing videos as easy as having a conversation.

To get the inside scoop, we sat down with three Google DeepMind team members who work on Omni: research scientist Mohammad Babaeizadeh, product manager Anish Nangia, and research engineer Sarah Xu. They shared their vision for Omni, explained why they started with video generation, and broke down what exactly makes Omni so helpful for creators.

They also let their imaginations run wild. Could Omni swap their hairstyles? Turn them into sloths? Materialize Sarah’s cat on the table in front of them? “There is no ceiling to this,” Mohammad said.

And what’s next for Omni? “It’s only going to get better from here,” Sarah said.

Watch the full interview below to learn more about Omni.

entries.title: Sharing between Pixel devices is now just a tap away.
entries.summary: Sharing between Android devices is even easier, starting with Pixel. Use Quick Share and tap to send contact info and more.
entries.content:
We’re making sharing between Android devices even simpler, starting with Pixel. Eligible devices can now use Quick Share and tap to send contact info, photos, videos, and more.

It’s easy to use, too — especially when you're swapping contact info. When you’re on your home screen, just bring your compatible Android device and another Android device close together for an instant, two-way exchange. To share photos or videos, open your phone’s Share Sheet and then tap the devices together. For more specifics, visit our Help Center.

The feature is rolling out today to Pixel 6 and newer devices, and it’s coming soon to the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, Fold8, and Flip8. We’ll expand to more Android devices by the end of the year.

entries.title: 7 can’t-miss updates from our Pixel 11 launch
entries.summary: Thumbnail image of YouTube video for the launch of Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL
entries.content:
The new Pixel 11 lineup is designed for Gemini Intelligence 1 and delivers impressive camera upgrades. From all-new image sensors to proactive and personalized assistance, our latest hardware is built to help you navigate your day-to-day so you can stay present for what matters most.

1. Get timely support from Gemini Intelligence.

We’re introducing a bunch of updates that deliver timely, proactive help and help you get things done. On Pixel devices, Gemini can handle even more multistep tasks across your favorite apps, expanding to more than 40 apps and counting 1 along with plenty more features you’ll find first on Pixel.

That includes Rambler, 2 our Gemini-powered voice input feature, which is built for the way you actually talk. It delivers fast, accurate voice input that transcribes your point cleanly and concisely — even when you use filler words, like “um” and “ah.”

And beyond Rambler, we’re introducing a couple more updates right in Gboard. 3 Sign-to-text functionality, which uses Google DeepMind’s Sign Language-to-Text (SL2T) model, allows signers to naturally sign messages while enhanced writing tools help craft relevant, tailored messages in your own personal style.

And Pixel 11 will offer timely, helpful information through easily glanceable cards in the apps you’re already using. So, for example, if a friend asks about a trip that’s coming up, a card with your booking details will pop up along with details if your flight is on time or delayed. 4

You’ll also see suggestions that are contextually relevant to the conversations you’re having. Like when you’re texting about dinner while rushing out the door, Pixel can step in to help, offering a proactive prompt suggestion to lock down your reservation with just a tap. 5

You’ll see this type of proactive help in many more places across your phone — like suggestions to save events to your Calendar, locations to Maps, or relevant information to Google Wallet, like membership numbers on airline or hotel apps.

Launching in Preview, your phone will also provide location-based insights. 5 Like when you’re waiting for a table at a new restaurant, your lock screen will proactively show that location and, with just a tap, offer insights — such as top menu items or the most popular seats — from hundreds of reviews and photos, right in Google Maps.

2. Stay present with Magic Capture.

Life’s most precious moments can happen in a flash. And we don’t want you to miss living in the moment as you try to capture it. With Magic Capture, you’ll be able to automatically snap those blink-and-you’ll-miss-it baby smiles, playful pets, or hard-to-get action shots — like a basketball frozen in mid air — with a single tap, all while you stay present and engaged.

In a typical session, Magic Capture uses both on-device intelligence and Gemini models to analyze around 400 frames to deliver perfectly-timed, high-quality 12-megapixel photos. And Magic Capture can even automatically apply edits like crop and unblur, so your moments are ready to share. Even better, you’ll also get a video without needing to go back and forth between modes.

3. Pick your aesthetic with Camera Looks.

Camera Looks allows you to choose the exact aesthetic you’re going for, right at the point of capture. Because while the Original Pixel look is widely loved, we know everyone has their own preferences.

Now, you can set a new default photo look with three alternative options: Natural (for relaxed details), Shadows (for deeper contrast), and Vanilla (for a warm, golden glow). To create our Camera Looks, we made adjustments such as merging fewer frames for a minimally processed feel or rewriting color-lookup tables and more to emulate classic film chemistry.

If you want to add even more personal style to your photos, you can choose from six additional Looks: Digi, Black Tie, Minimal, Editorial, Classic, and Velvet. And every Camera Look is fully customizable so your photos will perfectly reflect your vision.

4. Make content more easily with Creator Suite.

Creator Suite makes content creation even easier on Pixel.

That includes handy tools right in your viewfinder — like social media gridlines or an on-screen teleprompter that dynamically scrolls as you talk — allowing you to frame recordings and speak at your own pace and never miss a word. You’ll also get more organizational support, with your captured videos saved directly into project folders. And once your video’s recorded, use Storyboard to effortlessly trim and rearrange your clips.

Plus, you can now set video as your default mode when you open Pixel Camera, so you’re always ready for action.

5. Take low-light pictures much faster.

Pixel has always been great at capturing the stars, and Instant Night Sight makes low-light photography better than ever on Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL. You’ll now be able to capture Night Sight images up to 4.5 times faster 6 while still retaining the quality you’ve come to expect. Because when you’re shooting in low light, you shouldn't have to choose between a great shot and holding still.

6. Circle to search right from your camera.

Use Circle to Search in your Camera viewfinder to learn about things you see. For example, if you’re exploring a botanical garden, you can quickly point your camera at a flower, zoom in for a closer look, and use Circle to Search to instantly identify the species, find planting tips, or get more information. 7

7. Translate real-world content without interruption.

Translate videos and audio in real time with Live Translate. This technology leverages Live Translate’s real-time speech-to-speech translation capability, advanced on-device generative AI models powered by our Google Tensor G6 processor, automatically dubbing media from around the world into your preferred language. 8

Order Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL today.

Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL are available for preorder today, starting at $899, $1,099, and $1,299, respectively.

All three phones will be on shelves at the Google Store and through our retail partners on August 20. Visit the Google Store for more information on availability and product updates.
